trans.cn: (thùng chứa hoặc phòng) chống rò rỉ, kín nước; (lý thuyết, kế hoạch hoặc thỏa thuận) nghiêm ngặt, hoàn hảo
trans.cn_source: （容器或房间）防漏水的，水密的；（理论、计划或协议）严密的，无懈可击的

sentences.c: The rules state that samples must be enclosed in two watertight containers.
sentences.cn_source: 条例规定样品必须用两个不漏水的容器封装起来。

sentences.c: If she could just establish the time the picture had been taken, Mick would have a watertight alibi.
sentences.cn_source: 只要她能确定拍这张照片的时间，米克就可以有一个无懈可击的不在现场的证据。

sentences.c: Only teak matches oak's expansion coefficient and stays watertight.
sentences.cn_source: 只有柚木才能达到橡木的膨胀系数，并保持水密性。

trans.cn: hạnh phúc, an lạc; sự thịnh vượng (của một đất nước)
trans.cn_source: 幸福，安康；（国家的）繁荣

sentences.c: Singing can create a sense of well-being.
sentences.cn_source: 唱歌能产生一种幸福感。

sentences.c: But it estimates Mexican well-being at 22%.
sentences.cn_source: 但据估计，墨西哥人的幸福感指数为22%。

sentences.c: It has helped a lot to improve animals' well-being.
sentences.cn_source: 它对改善动物的健康有很大帮助。

trans.cn: nổi tiếng
trans.cn_source: 众所周知的

sentences.c: Helen is a very well-known novelist in Australia.
sentences.cn_source: 海伦是澳大利亚著名的小说家。

sentences.c: A well-known voice came over the airwaves.
sentences.cn_source: 电波传来了一个大家熟悉的声音。

sentences.c: Her father was a well-known racehorse breeder.
sentences.cn_source: 她的父亲是一位有名的赛马驯养者。

trans.cn: (để thể hiện sự tương phản) nhưng, tuy nhiên; while (dùng ở đầu tài liệu)
trans.cn_source: （表示对比）但是，然而；鉴于（用于文件的开头）

trans.cn: Lời nói đầu, lời khai mạc; câu lệnh có điều kiện
trans.cn_source: 序言，开场白；条件语句

sentences.c: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
sentences.cn_source: 有一些研究结果令人满意，然而其他的则不然。

sentences.c: She has authentic charm whereas most people simply have nice manners.
sentences.cn_source: 她有真正的魅力，而大多数人只是有礼貌而已。

sentences.c: Benefits are linked to inflation, whereas they should be linked to the cost of living.
sentences.cn_source: 救济金与通货膨胀联系了起来，而它们应该与生活费用挂钩。

trans.cn: đi nơi khác, đi nơi khác
trans.cn_source: 在别处，去别处

trans.cn: nơi khác, nơi khác
trans.cn_source: 别处，别的地方

sentences.c: Prices are higher here than elsewhere.
sentences.cn_source: 这里的价格比其他地方高。

sentences.c: Our troops are to be redeployed elsewhere.
sentences.cn_source: 我们的部队将被重新部署到其他地区。

sentences.c: The answer to the problem must be sought elsewhere.
sentences.cn_source: 这个问题的答案必须在别处寻找。

trans.cn: bất kể ai; bất cứ ai
trans.cn_source: 无论谁；任何人

trans.cn: “Yêu một người” (tên phim)
trans.cn_source: 《爱谁谁》（电影名）

sentences.c: Whoever thought up that joke?
sentences.cn_source: 究竟是谁想出那个笑话的？

sentences.c: Whoever heard of such a thing!
sentences.cn_source: 究竟有谁听说过这种事！

sentences.c: Come out of there, whoever you are.
sentences.cn_source: 不管你是谁，从那里出来吧。
